choose.when: case when max(coalesce(r.runtime_match_count, 0)) > 0 then true else false end as runtime_recognized, case when max(coalesce(r.runtime_match_count, 0)) > 0 then 'MATCHED' else 'MISSING_MATCH' end as runtime_status, cast(max(coalesce(r.runtime_match_count, 0)) as signed) as runtime_match_count, max(r.runtime_side) as runtime_side, max(r.runtime_title) as runtime_title, max(r.runtime_detail) as runtime_detail, max(r.runtime_locator) as runtime_locator, max(r.runtime_value_text) as runtime_value_text, max(r.runtime_confidence_level) as runtime_confidence_level, max(r.runtime_source_artifact) as runtime_source_artifact, max(r.runtime_locator_method) as runtime_locator_method
choose.otherwise: false as runtime_recognized, 'NO_RUNTIME' as runtime_status, 0 as runtime_match_count, null as runtime_side, null as runtime_title, '未选择 runtime，暂不判断运行过程是否识别' as runtime_detail, null as runtime_locator, null as runtime_value_text, null as runtime_confidence_level, null as runtime_source_artifact, null as runtime_locator_method

sql.if: left join ( select item_key, count(*) as runtime_match_count, group_concat(distinct runtime_side order by runtime_side separator '/') as runtime_side, max(concat(coalesce(table_title, '未命名表'), ' / runtime ', level)) as runtime_title, max(concat( '行：', coalesce(nullif(row_label, ''), nullif(row_key, ''), nullif(row_path, ''), '未识别行名'), '；列：', coalesce(nullif(column_label, ''), nullif(column_key, ''), nullif(column_path, ''), '未识别列名'), '；值：', coalesce(nullif(value_text, ''), nullif(value_signature, ''), '空') )) as runtime_detail, max(coalesce(nullif(cell_coordinate, ''), nullif(source_locator, ''), nullif(locator_method, ''))) as runtime_locator, max(coalesce(nullif(value_text, ''), nullif(value_signature, ''))) as runtime_value_text, max(confidence_level) as runtime_confidence_level, max(source_artifact) as runtime_source_artifact, max(locator_method) as runtime_locator_method from runtime_structure_item where project_id = #{projectId} and run_id = #{runId} and note_no = #{noteNo} and level = #{level} group by item_key ) r on r.item_key = s.item_key

choose.when:
select 'row' as level, s.item_key as item_key, max(s.note_no) as note_no, max(case when s.side = 'PDF' then concat(coalesce(s.table_title, '未命名表'), ' / 行') end) as pdf_title, max(case when s.side = 'PDF' then coalesce(nullif(s.row_path, ''), nullif(s.row_leaf, ''), s.row_key) end) as pdf_detail, max(case when s.side = 'PDF' then s.source_locator end) as pdf_locator, max(case when s.side = 'EXCEL' then concat(coalesce(s.table_title, '未命名表'), ' / 行') end) as excel_title, max(case when s.side = 'EXCEL' then coalesce(nullif(s.row_path, ''), nullif(s.row_leaf, ''), s.row_key) end) as excel_detail, max(case when s.side = 'EXCEL' then s.source_locator end) as excel_locator,
from structure_row s
where s.project_id = #{projectId} and s.note_no = #{noteNo}
and ( s.table_title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or s.row_key like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or s.row_path like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or s.row_leaf like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or s.source_locator like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
group by s.item_key
order by s.item_key

select 'column' as level, s.item_key as item_key, max(s.note_no) as note_no, max(case when s.side = 'PDF' then concat(coalesce(s.table_title, '未命名表'), ' / 列名') end) as pdf_title, max(case when s.side = 'PDF' then coalesce(nullif(s.column_path, ''), nullif(s.column_leaf, ''), s.column_key) end) as pdf_detail, max(case when s.side = 'PDF' then s.source_locator end) as pdf_locator, max(case when s.side = 'EXCEL' then concat(coalesce(s.table_title, '未命名表'), ' / 列名') end) as excel_title, max(case when s.side = 'EXCEL' then coalesce(nullif(s.column_path, ''), nullif(s.column_leaf, ''), s.column_key) end) as excel_detail, max(case when s.side = 'EXCEL' then s.source_locator end) as excel_locator,
from structure_column s
where s.project_id = #{projectId} and s.note_no = #{noteNo}
and ( s.table_title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or s.column_key like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or s.column_path like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or s.column_leaf like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or s.source_locator like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
group by s.item_key
order by s.item_key
choose.otherwise:
select 'cell' as level, s.item_key as item_key, max(s.note_no) as note_no, max(case when s.side = 'PDF' then concat(coalesce(s.table_title, '未命名表'), ' / 单元格') end) as pdf_title, max(case when s.side = 'PDF' then concat('行：', coalesce(nullif(s.row_path, ''), s.row_key, '未识别行名'), '；列：', coalesce(nullif(s.column_path, ''), s.column_key, '未识别列名'), '；值：', coalesce(nullif(s.value_text, ''), s.normalized_value, '空')) end) as pdf_detail, max(case when s.side = 'PDF' then s.source_locator end) as pdf_locator, max(case when s.side = 'EXCEL' then concat(coalesce(s.table_title, '未命名表'), ' / 单元格') end) as excel_title, max(case when s.side = 'EXCEL' then concat('行：', coalesce(nullif(s.row_path, ''), s.row_key, '未识别行名'), '；列：', coalesce(nullif(s.column_path, ''), s.column_key, '未识别列名'), '；值：', coalesce(nullif(s.value_text, ''), s.normalized_value, '空')) end) as excel_detail, max(case when s.side = 'EXCEL' then s.source_locator end) as excel_locator,
from structure_cell s
where s.project_id = #{projectId} and s.note_no = #{noteNo}
and ( s.table_title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or s.row_key like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or s.row_path like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or s.column_key like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or s.column_path like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or s.value_text like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or s.normalized_value like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or s.source_locator like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
group by s.item_key
order by s.item_key
